method: Original ROM damage routine bank 0 CPU $DFFF executed for all 36 profiles and all 256 input life bytes, with player/nonplayer targets and normal/Wookie level contexts
formula: If old < damage: new=0 and death timer is set. Otherwise new=old-damage; if (new XOR old) AND 0xF0 is nonzero, new |= 0x0F.
boundary_note: An exact subtraction to zero is distinct from arithmetic underflow. This tests the common routine only; special damage and caller-side checks remain separate.
interventions: Target life, profile, slot and level supplied explicitly
